chapter_seo_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Ch 464: Li Sui’s New Form & A Father’s Unshakable Love
chapter_meta_description: After the Heavenly Calamity, a blind Li Huowang must face the horrific truth of Li Sui’s new body. Will he see a monster, or his daughter?
og_title: A Blind Embrace for a Twisted Daughter
og_description: Li Huowang accepts his monstrous daughter in a chapter that redefines horror and family.
twitter_title: From Horror to Heart: Li Huowang’s Choice
twitter_description: Can love survive a face made of skinless dog and a body of writhing tentacles? Li Huowang says yes.

lore_anchors.definition: An ontological disaster in the Dao-Twisted World where a fundamental law of reality ceases to function; its aftermath often involves the permanent warping of people and places.
A parasitic, tentacled entity born from corrupted alchemy. It can possess and physically reshape other living bodies, absorbing their nature in the process.
Li Huowang’s dog, a female canine whose body was taken over and merged with by Li Sui during the Heavenly Calamity.
